data.title: 芙宁娜 · 深夜剧本案头创作
data.description: 午夜的剧团工作室只亮着一盏绿罩台灯，暖黄的光落在红木桌面与反复修改的剧本上。芙宁娜戴着贝雷帽，披深蓝开衫，一手压住手稿，另一手把羽毛笔杆的末端轻抵唇边，笔尖朝向墨水瓶。她没有急着落笔，而是盯着空白的一行，认真推敲下一句对白。
data.location: 剧团工作室实木书桌前
data.action: 坐在剧本桌前，一手压手稿，另一手将羽毛笔杆末端抵在唇边思考，笔尖远离嘴唇。
data.lighting: warm light from a green-shaded desk lamp
data.promptProse: She presses revised script pages flat while touching the blunt quill end to her lips, its inked nib pointing toward the inkwell. A single green-shaded desk lamp casts warm yellow light across the manuscript and mahogany table.
data.animaCaption: The blunt quill end touches her lips; its inked nib points toward the inkwell.
